mapper.sql: run_id AS runId, execution_id AS executionId, application_id AS applicationId, module, framework, test_type AS testType, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, duration_ms AS durationMs, total_count AS totalCount, passed_count AS passedCount, failed_count AS failedCount, skipped_count AS skippedCount, execution_status AS executionStatus, created_at AS createdAt
mapper.select: SELECT , content_hash AS contentHash FROM modernization_test_run WHERE execution_id=#{executionId}
SELECT FROM modernization_test_run ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.application_id AS applicationId, a.application_name AS applicationName, r.module, r.test_type AS testType, r.run_id AS runId, r.started_at AS startedAt, r.total_count AS totalCount, r.passed_count AS passedCount, r.failed_count AS failedCount, r.skipped_count AS skippedCount, r.execution_status AS executionStatus, CASE WHEN r.total_count - r.skipped_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(r.passed_count * 100.0 / (r.total_count - r.skipped_count), 1) END AS passRatePercent FROM modernization_test_run r JOIN modernization_application a ON a.application_id = r.application_id WHERE r.run_id = (SELECT x.run_id FROM modernization_test_run x WHERE x.application_id=r.application_id AND x.module=r.module AND x.test_type=r.test_type ORDER BY x.started_at DESC, x.run_id DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY r.application_id, r.test_type
